name: qfd_dv_s5_su8b

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every input and every output at its pin (priced c_su 2 -> 6); a flow pin register would add a second, unpriced edge

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands rst_n in two registered stages (rs0 -> rs1) and fans out through kept local reset leaves (<= 32 loads each)

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: RTL registers all 487 inputs and 1058 outputs at the pin (priced c_su 2 -> 6); rst_n lands rs0 -> rs1 (2 raw reset contacts) then kept local leaves; resets only control/valid state (datapath payload unreset, OWNER 09:05); no combinational pin arc (textbook in->reg/reg->out/in->out 0)
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: PASS (by floorplan): outline 216.0 x 108.0, no wire can exceed 324 um; gate wire_reach checks 405
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: PASS: actual ORFS pre-gate mapped native census results/arch/qw_su8_1020/native_repair2252/r2: 0 drivers > 32, max 32, 22,399 roots, rst_n 2 loads (kept qfd_dv_su8_kff/kffr copies held: keep_hierarchy, census on flat map)
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: mapped depth 443.4 ps (<= 600); stride multiples precomputed at accept, 24-bit Kogge-Stone prefix add
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: no dynamic table (VM/BTAB/PROG live in the VM8 group SRAMs); 4,712 FF all pipeline/control
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS (pin-bound): no macros; aspect 2.00; full std-cell area; faces N 768/216.0 = 3.56/um, E 247/108.0 = 2.29/um, W 487/108.0 = 4.51/um, S 45/216.0 = 0.21/um; util 14.6% (fill_reason pin_bound)
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: ONE CTS root (S-face ck) = one region (the slice2 SU/VM8 group region, P2); pin-flop spread <= 80 TT+FF judged in the gate; crossings to other regions land in parent rings; io_hold_margin 0.03
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: static: command/record visible c_su 2 -> 6 (+4 edges: start +1 pin +2 align, out pin +1), reset release +1 boot edge; BTAB answer bypasses SU (parent relay, gb 500 -> 244); NOTICE TOK.QW.SCHED (lanes/QW-TOKSCHED.md)

fill_reason.pin_bound: pin-bound control leaf: 1,545 registered boundary bits (N 768/216.0 = 3.56/um, E 247/108.0 = 2.29/um, W 487/108.0 = 4.51/um, S 45/216.0 = 0.21/um); the 768-bit lane address bus pd1 needs one >= 172.8 um face at <= ~4.5 pins/um; std-cell area 3416.12 um2 gives util 14.6%

structural_change: QW-SU8: SU control split from SUVM7 into its own hard leaf (VM -> VM8 group; BTAB bypass), stride precompute with lane-local kept mux boundaries (same latency), 2-stage reset landing; this kit = parallel fallback, flatter (216 x 108): lower N/E density, S band longer
